candidate_forecasts: forecasts/{F,U_query,S_query,L}.npz: [3,4,50], own candidate reference gas concentration ppm; F from native float32, compressed outputs float64; H0/H1 inference casts every method to float32
observables: scalar_observations/{Oxx,Dxx}.npz observed_ppm[50] float32, no particle/label/state field

reference_roles.reference: original two used by M2 and M4
reference_roles.extra_reference: additional two used for M4 and fixed pair sensitivity
reference_roles.diagnostic: six separate, never kernel fitting or formal confirmation

heads.H0: strict float32 C>float32(.1), Jeffreys frequency, mean Bernoulli log
heads.H1: empirical CRPS on log1p(C/1ppm), common M-specific F IQR, fallback1

reference_cache: Per physical frame: all original filament records [N,4] float32 x/y/z[m],sigma[cm]; per-particle native contribution [N,10]float32 ppm including explicit zeros; native float32 serial totals; planned-block exposure multiplicity
physical_time: QUERY_PHYSICAL_LINEAGE: target/actual/next saved time and frame; zero-order hold from latest actual saved time not after target
all_pose_matrix: F_REFERENCE_ALL_POSES.npz [3,4,50,14]; test matrix evaluation_only/[OID]_F_allposes [50,14]; auxiliary poses use F fallback, never primary infer
truth: evaluation_only/TRUTH_MAPPING.json consumed only for frozen prediction evaluation; not present in whitelisted infer subprocess
independence: 24 realizations with independently specified RNG streams; 50 temporal blocks/realization and 10 virtual stops are not independent experiments
geometry: Derived B task on locked B4 geometry; three hypotheses, static final wind10, virtual point schedule; no new PMFS navigation or original-paper statistical replication
M_names: M2 and M4 here denote reference ensemble sizes, not historical stopped method modules
